settings.showPetDesc: When off, the pet window is hidden and stays hidden on next launch.
settings.alwaysOnTopDesc: When on, the pet floats above other windows; when off, it can be covered like a normal window.
settings.developerDesc: Used to distinguish the pet window bounds from the actual video display area.
settings.debugFrameDesc: Show the window bounds and video area bounds, and display the live window and video sizes inside the pet window.
settings.sizeDesc: Change how big Vivi appears on your desktop. You can also scroll over Vivi to fine-tune.
settings.autoModeDesc: Vivi picks actions based on the time and your sessions. Turn off to keep the action you chose.

actions.sectionDescription: Hover an action to preview it, then click Play to have Vivi perform it on your desktop.
actions.needShowPet: Turn on Show Pet to play actions

stoat_sit_cushion_drink_tea_slow.label: Drink tea
stoat_sit_cushion_drink_tea_slow.description: Sips tea while waiting for a model reply or idling quietly.
